short_description: Sparse episodic control using weighted importance sampling and recorded behavior probabilities.

textbook.reference: Sutton and Barto, Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction, second edition

pedagogy.motivation: Learn how to reach a finish efficiently while exploring acceleration actions.
assumptions: Truncated episodes are silently skipped — no Q-update is made; the episode is still recorded in training_history
pedagogy.data_model: A trajectory records state, action, reward and its generating behavior probability.
pedagogy.what_is_missing: The expected return of each action and the greedy policy.
pedagogy.how_it_solves: Sweep completed episodes backward, form returns, update a weighted mean and improve the deterministic greedy target. Stop the sweep when the recorded action differs from the improved target.

update.label: Weighted mean
update.description: Cumulative weights are stored in the log domain to prevent overflow.

complexity.training: O(T A) per episode excluding environment traversal

weaknesses: Needs completed episodes for Q-value updates
High variance and slow exploration on maze-like or obstacle-dense tracks
If all episodes are truncated, raises EpisodeTruncatedError with a clear message
when_to_use: Small to medium discrete racetracks for studying episodic off-policy control.
